title_ja: 保護対象の文字列と値を維持する
requirement_en: Keep protected source fields unchanged, including names, prices, quantities, units and punctuation. Compare exact source sequences; visual similarity does not establish preservation.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Compare the approved input and extracted output only where a supported exact-text extractor exists; otherwise require manual evidence. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not rewrite protected fields. A newly authorized source revision establishes a new comparison baseline, not a silent correction.

exception_policy.bounds: No waiver for silently changed protected content; explicitly editable fields are outside the protected scope.

title_ja: 実在する根拠のない主張を載せない
requirement_en: Trace performance numbers, endorsements, customer identities and logos to supplied evidence and usage permission. Missing proof is not permission to invent a plausible claim.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Review each factual assertion and asset against supplied evidence; this is not an automated semantic-truth detector. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Remove or flag unsubstantiated claims only under explicit refine authorization; never fabricate replacement testimonials or metrics.

exception_policy.bounds: Clearly labeled fictional material can be outside real-world claim scope; it must not imply actual customers or achievements.

title_ja: 不可視文字と空白の必要性を確かめる
requirement_en: Identify newly added invisible characters or spacing by source comparison and explain their function. Preserve intentional separators, combining marks and variation selectors instead of deleting every nonprinting code point.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: An exact code-point diff can locate changes; deciding whether they are legitimate requires context and may require manual review. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: No blanket whitespace stripping or deletion of joiners, variation selectors or combining characters.

exception_policy.bounds: Intentional source characters are not violations merely because they are invisible; unsupported extraction remains not-checked.

title_ja: 原稿へ一括の文字正規化をかけない
requirement_en: Do not apply blanket Unicode normalization to source content. Preserve compatibility forms, original punctuation, variation sequences and decomposed characters unless a specific editable field has separate explicit authorization.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Compare original code points, not only normalized strings; no normalization-based equality shortcut proves preservation. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Never use broad NFKC or NFC rewriting as an unrequested typography repair. Keep authorized derived search data separate from source.

exception_policy.bounds: A separately authorized derived field may have its own transformation; protected source remains exact.

title_ja: 素材の由来と利用条件を残す
requirement_en: Record origin, source identifier, license or permission basis and intended use for images, fonts and other assets. Unavailable rights evidence must remain an explicit limitation.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect actual rights records and asset provenance; a URL or attractive preview alone is not permission. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not infer a license, copy a font file or redistribute source figures to fill missing metadata.

exception_policy.bounds: Original or public-domain material still needs an attributable provenance record; unverifiable rights cannot be labeled verified.

title_ja: 制作前に目的と構成判断を固定する
requirement_en: Record the actual purpose, audience, information priorities, intended action and a purpose-specific structure rationale before production. Verify current attributable authorization for that exact contract and scope; later explanations do not replace missing chronology.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Inspect preserved brief/contract bytes, production boundary and independently verified authorization; a true boolean or opaque approval reference cannot establish chronology or authority. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not fabricate an earlier decision, backdate a contract or change protected content. A new authorized refine pass gets its own prior contract and retains the earlier failure.

exception_policy.bounds: No waiver for retroactive justification or missing production permission. Legitimate brand constraints must be recorded before use, and a fresh refine contract only governs its new production boundary.

title_ja: 構成の再利用を実際の目的で説明する
requirement_en: Choose structure from the brief instead of repeating the same Hero/cards/CTA arrangement across materially different objectives without justification. Review repeated structures against actual information relationships; changing accent colors alone is not a structural rationale.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

conditions.when: An explicit strict review policy was selected before production and materially different briefs receive repeated structure without a purpose-specific rationale.
conditions.scope: compared structures under that declared policy

verification.notes: Compare briefs, chosen structures and their reasons using assisted or manual review. Three peer choices may legitimately use three cards; no motif counter is a design-quality detector. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Propose a purpose-specific information structure within refine authorization. Do not remove useful brand components solely for novelty or infer a failure from the number of cards.

exception_policy.bounds: An approved brand component that fits the actual information can pass on its merits. Any genuine project waiver requires current authorized scope/reason/expiry/subject binding and stays waived.

title_ja: 表示する装飾と主張と操作に実体を持たせる
requirement_en: Use visual elements because they explain information, support hierarchy or provide a real action. Do not populate empty layout regions with invented metrics, testimonials, customer assets or simulated controls presented as actual functionality.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

conditions.when: Decoration or simulated UI misrepresents real claims/functions or obstructs necessary information; content and permission blockers retain their independent severity.
conditions.scope: misrepresented claim/control or obscured information

verification.notes: Trace real-world claims and assets to evidence/rights; examine whether each control actually works and whether decoration obscures reading. An assisted design review is not a semantic-truth detector. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not invent replacements or unauthorized assets. Distinguish a clearly labeled explanatory diagram from a real interface and preserve source information during approved changes.

exception_policy.bounds: Clearly labeled original fiction or noninteractive explanation may be outside real-world claim/control scope. There is no waiver for deception, unsupported claims or concealed necessary information.

title_ja: ブランドの連続性と企画の構成を分ける
requirement_en: Keep protected brand identity and useful approved conventions consistent while tailoring structure to each actual purpose. Difference between projects does not require arbitrary changes to every familiar component.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Compare the current brief with attributable brand constraints, authorized components and observed readability. Brand approval alone does not prove that a component suits this brief. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not change protected identity or navigation to appear novel. Request scoped refine authorization for a justified campaign-specific adaptation.

exception_policy.bounds: A bounded authorized adaptation may differ from the normal brand pattern; verify current approval and preserve unaffected brand obligations and readable access.

title_ja: 色と書体と余白を役割で定義する
requirement_en: Assign color, typography and spacing choices to explicit information and interaction roles. Match the definitions to actual available fonts/assets and rendered output, including permitted fallback treatment.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Inspect role tokens and their actual rendering, contrast/readability, glyph coverage and fallback. Token names or an adopted system example do not prove availability or universal suitability. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not import fonts without authorization and rights or silently rewrite source to fit a token. Propose only scoped changes and record unavailable rendering as untested.

exception_policy.bounds: An authorized local brand or fallback treatment can differ from default tokens if its roles and actual readability are evidenced; a genuine waiver needs bounded current approval.

title_ja: 形式だけでデザインを排除しない
requirement_en: Evaluate a card layout, gradient, symmetry or other visual treatment against the actual purpose, brand constraints and readability. Neither the presence nor absence of a named motif establishes quality or a design-origin verdict.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Review purpose-specific reasons and observed readable access; a motif count cannot replace contextual judgment. Judge the actual design rather than infer its origin. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not ban whole families of treatment or blindly approve a brand motif. Propose changes only where evidence identifies a real mismatch or reading problem.

exception_policy.bounds: A deliberate approved treatment can pass when its actual use is appropriate; exceptions cannot hide required information or substitute for readability evidence.

title_ja: 結果状態と未実施を混ぜない
requirement_en: Keep passed, failed, needs-review, not-checked, unsupported, waived and not-applicable distinct. A pass needs a named method and relevant evidence; no missing renderer or unrun check becomes a pass.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.

exception_policy.bounds: Verified inapplicability uses its own status; it does not waive evidence requirements or authenticate an unrun test.

title_ja: 使用した版と環境を識別する

title_ja: 例外の承認者と期限と対象を照合する
requirement_en: For a waiver or design exception, resolve the required approval record and verify authorized approver, scope, reason, finite UTC expiry, exact subject and latest revocation state. Reject missing, expired, mismatched or unverifiable approvals.

fix_policy.guidance: Keep a valid waiver distinct from passed; do not fabricate approver identity, extend expiry or reuse approval for another artifact.

exception_policy.bounds: There is no waiver of the approval-bounds requirement; a valid approved exception concerns the associated substantive rule only.
